style: Read clearly and naturally, at a moderate pace
lines: Drive the cart and watch three graphs draw at once: position, velocity and acceleration.
Hand control. Drag the cart. Its velocity and acceleration are worked out from how you move it.
Throttle control. You set the velocity. Position is the running total of it.
Pedal control. You set the acceleration. Velocity builds up from it, then position from velocity.
Move across a finished run. The slope of each graph is the value of the one below it.
Pick a target graph and match it as closely as you can. Your best run comes back as a ghost.
This is the hard way. You control a graph two steps away from the target.
Watch the moment the cart turns around. Its velocity is zero, but is its acceleration?
Drag the cart. The computer works out your velocity and acceleration.
You set the speed and direction. Position is the running total.
You set the push. Velocity builds up from it, and position from velocity.
Pick a target, then press Start. Keep your solid line inside the shaded band for the whole run.
